findings.title: Login handler emits no audit-log entry
findings.label: spec-gap
findings.claim: The spec requires an audit-log entry on every login attempt; none is emitted.
findings.detail: The adversarial verifier errored mid-refute (a tool failure), so its one vote is dead and tallies into abstained. With valid 0 below the quorum of 1, huginn-quorum-v1 resolves the finding as abstained: KEPT and flagged as unverified rather than silently dropped — the degraded contract. verified is false and the review-model renders it as 'unverified-flagged'.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit an audit-log record (actor, ip, outcome) on each login attempt, success or failure.

degradedReasons.detail: the risk-classify finder errored mid-run and returned no parseable output

summary: Degraded review: the risk-classify finder died mid-run and is missing from this run's coverage (degradedReasons: finder-died). Separately, the adversarial VERIFY pass errored part-way on F1, so that finding is retained as unverified-flagged (verified:false) rather than dropped. degraded is true; recommendedEscalation is moderate (verdict 'fix').
